title: OURSELF Æ Packet to Kernel Envelope — v1.0
description: Versioned contract for translating OURSELF route-plan output and Æ packets into kernel proposals. Both the control plane (ourself-agent-bridge) and kernel (agent-bridge) must use byte-identical copies of this schema.

packet.description: The deterministic Æ packet from the control plane. Preserves all OURSELF route-plane fields without renaming or mutation.

packet_id.description: Deterministic packet identifier, prefixed 'ae-' by the generator.

created.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the packet was created (injected deterministically, not from Date.now()).

route.description: The classified route: e.g., 'blueprint', 'reverse_engineer', 'discard', etc. Comes directly from route-classifier.

execution_class.description: The execution class assigned by the control plane. Must be recognized by the kernel's EXECUTION_CLASSES registry.

status.description: Planning status. 'planned' = eligible for kernel review; 'discarded' = unsafe, kernel must reject.

node.description: The OURSELF node that originated the command: Jaxk, Kay, Nae, Milly, or OURSELF.

raw_text.description: The unparsed user-provided text that generated this packet.

target.description: Optional target path or identifier for the operation.

risk.description: Risk level assigned by the control plane.

parent_aecho.description: Optional parent AECHO identifier for command chaining.

route_plan.description: The route plan from the control plane. Preserves all fields produced by route-classifier and plan-endpoint.

route.description: The classified route, mirrored from packet.route.

sia.description: Semantic Integrity Assurance node assigned by the control plane.

execution_class.description: The execution class, mirrored from packet.execution_class.

requires_approval.description: Whether the kernel must require HUMAN-TURN approval before execution.

proof_required.description: Evidence/proof artifacts required for this operation.

origin.description: Metadata about where the envelope came from.

self.description: The repository identifier of the control plane.

source.description: Source within the control plane: 'cli-mouth', 'command-mouth', 'router', etc.

authority.description: Authority state and governance rules for kernel acceptance.

state.description: Must be PENDING_HUMAN_TURN. Any other state is rejected by the kernel.

human_turn_required.description: Must be true. The kernel always requires HUMAN-TURN for acceptance or rejection.

requested_execution.description: What the control plane is requesting the kernel to do.

class.description: The execution class requested. Must be recognized by the kernel's EXECUTION_CLASSES registry. Kernel MUST NOT accept unknown classes.

mutation_requested.description: Whether the requested operation performs mutation.

items.description: Safe token (matches SAFE_TOKEN regex from control plane). Must not contain paths, secrets, or unsafe characters.

expected_evidence.description: Array of evidence artifacts or identifiers expected to accompany this proposal.

semantic_checksum.description: Deterministic checksum computed from canonicalized semantic input (packet + route_plan + requested_execution). Must be reproducible given the same semantic inputs, independent of key insertion order, timestamps, or environment.
